reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Add config to the Vault issuer to allow the server-name to be specified when validating the certificates the Vault server presents", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new optional configuration is added; the text states no operational consequence for operators who do nothing.

proposed.statement: A new optional Vault issuer config lets the server-name be specified when validating the certificates the Vault server presents.
